result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: the active bottom navigation state appears wrong for the displayed page, the fixed bottom navigation overlaps content, and a horizontally scrolling category chip is awkwardly clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights “Profile” as the active tab, but the visible content is the home/restaurant discovery page. This creates a confusing mismatch between navigation state and page content.
issues.suggestion: Set “Home” as the active tab on this screen, or navigate to/show profile content when “Profile” is active.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar appears to overlay the restaurant list content; the lower pizza card is partially hidden behind the fixed nav area.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The category filter row is clipped on the right, showing only a small cut-off portion of the next pill after “Healthy,” which looks accidental.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll spacing, add a fade indicator, or ensure the next chip is either more visibly peeking or not visible at all.
